faults.description: A configuration change switched the orchestrator's planner prompt to version v42, whose output is prose instead of the expected JSON tool plan, so plans fail to parse and conversations abort.

decisive.contains: could not parse tool plan from model output (planner prompt v42): expected JSON object, got prose

trap: the change is a config change (not a deploy) and the first change lookup times out; the failure metric sits on llm-gateway, which deployed four minutes earlier
